name: Ace
description: Gives teams a local, multiplayer coding workspace where people and agents share channels across machines on Tailscale and land work as pull requests.

skills.name: Shared Channels
skills.description: Runs channels on your own machine where teammates and agents chat, join each other's work and drive agents together.

skills.name: Lanes as Pull Requests
skills.description: Runs each unit of work in its own Git worktree and branch, called a lane, that lands as a pull request.

skills.name: Local Tools and Apps
skills.description: Runs agents with your shell, toolchains and signed-in CLIs such as Xcode, Bun, Docker and gh on your own Mac.

skills.name: While You Were Away
skills.description: Summarizes who said what and what the agents finished in a channel while you were away from it.

skills.name: Cloud Channels (Beta)
skills.description: Keeps a channel working in your team's own cloud account, in a Linux container, while every laptop is closed.
